semantics.description: Import asset register data from Excel (xlsx) to AVEVA Engineering (PDMS/E3D). Reads grid data via NETGRIDCONTROL/NETDATASOURCE, iterates rows to create new elements (CREATEELEMENT/ELEMENTTYPE) or update existing element attributes (ATTRIBUTE/dbref), logs all issues to CSV file.
keyOperations: ATTRIBUTE object creation for UDA updates

kbGaps: NETGRIDCONTROL / NETDATASOURCE constructor and method patterns
ATTRIBUTE object creation and attribute assignment via dbref
findfirst() return type and .set() validity test
changesFromOriginal: Customer OneDrive paths replaced with generic AVEVA_SERVER paths
Nested 'handle any' inside 'if' block consolidated into single handler per if-block (semantically equivalent, cleaner structure)
$() block-comment preprocessor directives removed (not pure PML syntax, conditional compilation artifacts)
Redundant inner 'handle any' for SetElementTypeByName errors removed (outer handler covers same scope)
